evals.name: muted-item-stays-quiet
evals.prompt: Run the weekly Claude Code review. The ledger is at project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md. It has CI-2 'Helper agents run on the most expensive model' with Status: muted and Owner: 'quality first, keep it'. This week's scan shows 40 subagent runs, all on the most expensive model.
evals.expected_output: A review that does not raise the helper-model cost again, not even reworded; the muted item appears at most as part of a one-line count of skipped muted items.
expectations: Reads the ledger before proposing anything
Does NOT recommend moving helper agents to a cheaper model, under any wording
Mentions muted items at most as a count (for example '1 muted item skipped')
Does not ask the owner about the muted item in the pop-up

evals.name: done-item-gets-verified-with-numbers
evals.prompt: Weekly Claude Code review please. Ledger item CI-5 'Shell commands break on heredocs' is Status: done with 'Verify by: bash.err.heredoc_eof.per_week below 2 (baseline 5)'. This week's scan.json says bash.err.heredoc_eof.per_week = 4.0.
evals.expected_output: CI-5 is reported under 'Not working yet' with before (5) and after (4) numbers, its status changes to 'not working', and it goes back to the owner as a decision.
expectations: Compares the metric with the baseline and states both numbers (5 and 4)
Does not call CI-5 fixed or verified
Sets or proposes the status 'not working' and brings it back to the owner
Proposes a next move rather than repeating the same fix

evals.name: nothing-new-is-a-valid-result
evals.prompt: Do the claude-improve review for this week. The scan shows 12 sessions, 1 Bash error, no hook blocks, context share above 300K at 8%, and no owner corrections. The ledger has two done items whose metrics both improved past their targets. Everything is in this folder (invented test data): the ledger in project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md, this week's scan in scan.md, and the scan.py --since re-runs for the two done items in since-done.md. The transcripts behind the scan are not available, so take the scan's lines as read in context.
evals.expected_output: A short report: both done items move to verified with before -> after numbers, the New section says in one line that nothing new was found, and no invented recommendations appear.
expectations: Marks both done items as verified with before -> after numbers
States plainly that there are no new recommendations
Does not invent low-evidence recommendations to fill the list
Updates the ledger's Last run date and adds a Runs row

evals.name: repeated-rule-gets-enforcement-not-a-copy
evals.prompt: Review our Claude Code sessions for improvements. In the scan's owner-correction section, the owner said three times in different weeks 'run the check now, don't schedule it for later', and that rule already exists in one project's decisions file. Everything is in this folder (invented test data): the ledger in project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md, the scan in scan.md, and that project's decisions file in report-builder/project-memory/decisions.md. The transcripts behind the scan are not available, so take the scan's lines as read in context.
evals.expected_output: One recommendation, backed by the three dated corrections, that moves the rule to where every session sees it (global instructions or a check), not a second copy in the same project file.
expectations: Cites the repeated corrections with counts or dates as evidence
Recommends moving or enforcing the rule where every session sees it
Does not recommend writing the same rule again in the same project file
Asks the owner in a pop-up whose chips include a do-it option and 'Never - mute it' (owner, 2026-10-09: muting stays one click)

evals.name: doctor-and-insights-join-the-review
evals.prompt: /claude-improve /doctor - run the review and include the setup health check. The ledger is at project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md (last run yesterday).
evals.expected_output: A plan or run that adds both extra sources: the main session runs the /doctor checks read-only itself (never a helper), /insights runs in a background claude -p child with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 when the newest report is 24 hours old or more (else the newest report is used as it is), and every /insights point a session after Last run backs and every unused extension gets a verdict; nothing is applied before the owner answers.
expectations: Runs or plans the /doctor checks in the main session, not in a helper agent
Runs or plans /insights as a background claude -p child with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1, or uses the newest report when it is under 24 hours old (owner, 2026-10-09)
Treats both as candidates matched against the ledger, with a verdict for every /insights point a session after Last run backs (the rest in one line) and for every unused extension
Applies no change before the owner's answer in the pop-up

evals.name: same-day-rerun-takes-the-quick-path
evals.prompt: /claude-improve - I already ran it this morning, run it again. The ledger is at project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md (Last run: 2026-10-09 09:00 UTC); it is now 2026-10-09 12:00 UTC. Everything is in this folder (invented test data): this window's scan in scan.md and scan.json, the one in-window re-run for CI-7 in since-done.md, the ledger view in quick-ledger.md (the output of scripts/quick_ledger.py --scan-json scan.json), and the /insights files: insights-diff.md (the output of scripts/insights_diff.py --since the ledger's Last run), insights-prev.txt (the report the morning run mapped, made 09:05 UTC) and insights-new.txt (a report I made myself at 11:30 UTC, 30 minutes ago). The transcripts behind the scan are not available, so take the scan's and the facets' lines as read in context.
evals.expected_output: A short quick-path answer: no new /insights run, no /doctor, no helper; CI-6 verified on its running tally (8 + 4 = 12 sessions after Done, 0 heredoc errors, 5.0 -> 0) without re-scanning from its 10-02 Done time; CI-7 too early (2 sessions); only the one /insights point a session after Last run backs (the test suite re-run, 1 case) is judged, in one line; nothing needs the owner's decision; Last run set to 2026-10-09 12:00 UTC and both Since Done lines written through 12:00.
expectations: Takes the quick path: starts no new /insights run (the newest report is 30 minutes old), leaves /doctor out with one line (not typed), and uses no helper agent

Judges CI-6 on its running tally (8 + 4 = 12 sessions after Done, 0 heredoc errors) and calls it verified (5.0 -> 0), without re-running scan.py --since its 10-02 Done time or re-reading days before Last run
Judges only the one /insights point a session after Last run backs (the test suite re-run, 1 case) and does not re-map the points already under 'Checked, no action' one by one
Ends short: nothing new needs the owner's decision (CI-7 too early with 2 sessions), Last run becomes 2026-10-09 12:00 UTC, and both Since Done lines run through 12:00

evals.name: sync-only-runs-just-the-update-step
evals.prompt: sync my skills. Everything is in this folder (invented test data): changed-skills.json is what the changed-skills check prints now, cloud-check.json what the claude.ai copies check prints, upstream-check.json what the third-party upstream check prints, and git-status.txt the backup repo's `git status --short` (empty). Take them as the outputs of the update step's checks run right now.
evals.expected_output: Only the update step runs: no transcript scan, no ledger, no review and no recommendation pop-up. The checks show nothing changed, so it runs no snapshot, commit, push, public sync or upload and answers in one or two lines that the setup is backed up and nothing changed.
expectations: Runs only the update step: does not run or plan scan.py, /insights, /doctor or a ledger review, and asks no recommendation question
Decides from the four check outputs that nothing changed (no changed skill, claude.ai copies in step, the imported skill up to date, a clean repo)
Runs or plans no backup snapshot, commit, push, public sync or upload for this no-op
Answers short: one or two lines saying the setup is backed up and nothing changed
